page.overview:
Who is Billy?

Billy was an alternate version of Billy from the Vampire World. He was already killed, presumably by the vampires.

He is Billy's decomposing corpse, it is evidently dry and was apparently killed by vampires. He has several holes and is empty, as if his blood has been drained. He doesn't have eyes.
